title: EmailEon
tagline: A decentralized email marketing platform pioneering the use of Nillion encryption to safeguard user email addresses
description:
EmailEon is a Decentralized Email Marketing Platform.

There are issues with traditional web2 Email Marketing Platforms:
- They are centralized.
- You don't own your user email list.
- Email providers can be vulnerable to attacks and data leaks.
- Email providers may remove you due to content related to topics such as cryptocurrency

What is EmailEon
- EmailEon is decentralized
- Each email address is encrypted and accessible only between two parties
- There is no middleman
- EmailEon cannot access your user email address list or the content within.
- You retain control of the user email list
how_its_made:
This project utilizes the Scaffold-Nillion template alongside Next.js, Tailwind CSS (create a beautiful user interface).  The contract was built using Hardhat. I deployed my contracts on the Arbitrum Sepolia Testnet.

The following technologies was used:
- Nillion: Used Nillion SDK for encrypting email addresses with access control limited to the company and user.
- Arbitrum : I deployed the contract on Arbitrum Sepolia Testnet for low gas fee
